title: Every finished run states its replay verdict: Retry only where it can run
deviations_from_card: (1) Per the prompt, the verdict also weighs the SEAT: replayVerdict takes an optional hasCapability and returns {replayable:false, reason:'no-seat'} when the caller lacks taskKindCapability(kind), so a row the retry door would 403 is not offered Retry. The list routes pass callerCapabilities(). A third reason code no-seat was added next to inputs-gone / kind-retired. (2) The status-agnostic half is exported as replayBlock(kind, params, exists); the retry route calls it (scoped retries included) in place of replayInputsMissing, keeping its existing order (seat -> retryDecision -> TASK_KIND_UNKNOWN -> TASK_REPLAY_INPUTS_GONE -> buckets). (3) attachReplayVerdicts does NOT call loadParams when the page has no dead path-bearing rows (at most once per GET, zero when unneeded); pinned. (4) Route cases live in a new app/api/tasks/replay-verdict.test.ts (behavioural GET/history/retry on the unit DB) rather than inside tasks-route-tenancy.test.ts, whose anchor was moved to replayBlock(task.kind, params, existsSync) and still forbids a private replayInputsMissing. (5) Commit order is catalogs -> docs -> perf-budget -> feat -> test (not test-first) so every commit is green; the test commit follows the feat it pins. (6) perf-budget.json: named overrides for app/api/tasks/route.ts and app/api/tasks/[id]/retry/route.ts at 230 modules (+1, app/_lib/task-replay.ts), KB left at the group ceiling 3067; measured base+my files via git archive: 230 modules / 3065 KB, within budget.
notes: Full npm run test:unit exit 1 on the shared tree, NOT from this card: erasure-full-scrub.test.ts BROKEN because a sibling's uncommitted app/_lib/interview-letter-types.ts imports an untracked app/_lib/contract-constants.generated (module not found), and app/api/sim/reset/reset-route.test.ts FLAKED. Every tasks test passes: task-replay (10), task-view (9), tasksTabHelpers (14), replay-verdict (4), tasks-route-tenancy (8), tasks/route.test.ts (14), task-fanout (8), db/tasks-tenancy (1). npm run test:perf on the live checkout lists many ceilings over, all from siblings' uncommitted files except the two task routes (+1 module, mine), which the committed override covers; measured base daad5df9f + this card's files in a git-archive tree: 'perf:budget: within budget'. tsc: only foreign errors (untracked kpi-sim/ and a sibling's ProfileRosterRefreshBar.tsx awaiting catalog keys). The Analyze door navigates in-shell via useShellNavigate + buildTabSwitchUrl; its label key is tasks.replay.openAnalyze (the only path-bearing kind today; INPUTS_DOOR in tasksTabHelpers.ts maps kind -> tab). TasksRowActions.tsx render itself is not unit-covered (a .tsx); both themes use token classes only (text-steel, text-coral, decoration-coral/40).
